facts.name: House of Prime Rib
facts.label: House of Prime Rib
facts.tagline: Prime rib carved tableside from stainless-steel carts in an English-style dining room on Van Ness Avenue.
facts.address: 1906 Van Ness Ave, San Francisco, CA 94109
facts.contactOnly: Their own site describes the cuts and included sides without publishing dinner prices. Reserve a table or call for current prices.

panels.head: Cuts & included sides
body: Their dinner menu offers the City Cut, House of Prime Rib Cut, English Cut and King Henry VIII Cut, plus a children’s prime rib dinner for ages eight and under and the day’s fresh fish. Ask the restaurant for current prices.
Prime rib dinners include their salad bowl, mashed potatoes or a baked potato, Yorkshire pudding, creamed spinach and fresh cream of horseradish sauce.
